expectedIssues: Loading spinner is shown on top of already loaded content
reportedIssues: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image still shows a centered loading spinner overlaying the artwork, suggesting the image load never resolved (or the spinner is not dismissed once the image renders).
The third 'Fastest near you' card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge and its title is hard-truncated with no ellipsis, so the name is unreadable.
The second card in 'Popular right now' (the pizza, −20%) is clipped by the fixed bottom navigation bar; its title, rating and delivery info are not visible and the list appears to end abruptly.
The favorite (heart) button on the pizza card uses a dark translucent circle with a dark outline icon, giving poor contrast, while the ramen card uses a white circle — inconsistent treatment.
The category chip row is clipped mid-chip at the right edge with no visible affordance (fade or arrow) indicating it scrolls horizontally.
The '€0 delivery' badge on the ramen image duplicates the '€0 delivery' text in the card metadata line, creating redundant information.
The notification bell shows an unlabeled red dot and the icon-only buttons (bell, hearts) have no visible text label, which may lack accessible names for screen readers.
